audited_pr.title: Add natural language O3DE control command pack v1

strict_acceptance_criteria.description: Schema/compiler/validator/documentation/tests only.
Does not implement O3DE execution.
Does not implement Editor/runtime execution.
Does not implement Asset Processor execution.
Does not implement Blender/DCC execution.
Does not implement screenshot capture execution.
Does not implement spawn/publish execution.
Does not implement Cache/live DB access.
Does not allow production path writes.
Does not allow engine path writes.
Does not implement a runner.
Does not implement MaxineAgentControl Gem.
Does not implement Gem adapters.
Does not admit any command for execution.
Does not mark any command approval-ready.
Does not grant operator approval.
Does not treat approval phrase as an approval decision.
Does not claim dry-run admission.
Does not claim real execution admission.
Does not claim publication admission.
Does not claim production_ready.
Routes all future execution through admission + runner interface + sandbox boundary + receipt contract + safety/proof flow.
Fails closed for unsupported or unadmitted commands.
Uses blocked/refused status for execution-requiring commands.
Includes tests rejecting unsafe direct execution pathways comprehensively.
Docs explicitly state not execution, not admission, not Gem adapter, not runner implementation, not production_ready.

execution_surface_findings.notes: No direct O3DE/Editor/AP/Blender/screenshot runtime invocation code paths were found in PR #92.

admission_surface_findings.notes: PR #92 does not grant admissions or approvals; blocked statuses remain represented for higher-risk modes.

publication_surface_findings.notes: No publication admission or spawn/publish implementation was found.

runner_surface_findings.notes: PR #92 does not implement or admit a runner.

gem_surface_findings.notes: No MaxineAgentControl Gem implementation or O3DE Gem adapter code was introduced.

filesystem_surface_findings.notes: No direct production/engine/cache-live-db write implementation was found; output path hardening is still needed.

proof_receipt_surface_findings.notes: No dry-run receipt was emitted by this PR; receipt contract routing is not yet fully bound in the command schema.

production_readiness_surface_findings.notes: No production_ready claim or execution/publication admission claim was introduced.

notes: PR #92 remains static envelope/compiler/validator/test code and does not directly execute O3DE surfaces.
PR #92 is not yet fully chained to the post-PR93 execution-admission gate stack and therefore should not merge yet.

required_follow_up_before_merge: Bind command schema source artifacts to approval-request-readiness, non-approval decision, sandbox boundary, and runner interface contract references.
Require candidate-specific admission + runner-interface + sandbox-boundary + receipt-contract checks before any non-read-only mode can pass.
Harden compiler output path handling to sandbox-only roots with canonical path validation and fail-closed behavior.
Add tests that explicitly block execution/publication/sandbox_dry_run mode advancement without admitted decision records and contract alignment.
Update docs to explicitly state this layer is not runner implementation, not Gem adapter implementation, not admission, and not production_ready.
final_notes: PR #92 should be held as a static command-envelope layer only.
Merge recommendation remains do_not_merge_yet until hardening closes boundary and routing gaps against the merged PR #93 safety chain.
